<!-- pr-reviewer: e148edd179debf86035510ed147732ef192e9ca0 -->
Reviewed on the cheap tier at the maintainer's instruction. This PR changes collision verdicts (the shank/holder reach law, the mid-turn sweep, the solid laws, posed rapids and the rotary field law now read a tool body's band stack instead of its enclosing cylinder), so it is under AGENTS.md's safety floor and its review should run at the high tier; treat this pass as a first screen, not the full verdict.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** It also does not merge cleanly with `main` yet (conflict below), and it must be retargeted to `main` before #837 merges (it is stacked on `issue/743-sim-revolved-tool-body`; #837 targets `main`).

### Build status
Not built. The trial merge with `origin/main` (2046357b) conflicts in one file, so per the review rules nothing was compiled or run:

```
CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs
  <<<<<<< HEAD        pub mod body_judged;
  =======             /// #339 slice 5: links routed over the setup's fixtures.
                      pub mod fixture_route;
  >>>>>>> origin/main
```
Both sides added a module line; keeping both resolves it. Test and clippy results: none in this pass.

### What looks good
- The band stack is contiguous by construction: `HolderProfile::stack` (crates/tools/src/holder_profile.rs:213-221) and the clipped envelope and merge (holder_profile.rs:163, 300-320) leave no gap between bands from the shank top to the holder top.
- Every refusal path in `BodyBands::of` returns `None`, which is the enclosing cylinder: crates/sim/src/verify/body_bands.rs:50, 62, 68, 76, 84. `Cutter::judged` falls back to the flat (cylinder) cutter when the real tip disagrees (probe.rs:95-106), and `holder_bands` gives the cylinder when `body` is `None` (probe.rs:66-72). I found no path that ends with no holder judged at all.
- The conservatism tests are not vacuous: `reach_at` returns `NEG_INFINITY` where no band covers z (tool_body_judged.rs:40-45), so a gap fails; the mesh test samples every facet on a 24-step barycentric grid, and the drawn test samples 201 points per segment and asserts the convex bulge (>15) is among them (tool_body_judged.rs:77-171).
- Non-test code adds no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic`. The `expect`s are in tests only. The band write `out.b[out.n]` (body_bands.rs:80) is bounded by the cap check at line 50.
- The stepped-body readings match the PR table: nose clear and flange above the wall gives no warning (tool_body_judged.rs:216-227); flange in the wall gives ShankHit; nose in the wall gives ShankHit, reported once (229-239).
- Every `Cutter` literal in the diff sets `body`. Production sites: generate.rs:2572 (`with_body`), and both `VerifyContext` literals pass `Some(cutter)` (generate.rs:2754, 3060). Kept-cylinder sites are explicit: probe_op.rs:150-160 (`body: None`, named in a comment and by `probe_note`), cross_part.rs:52 (`Cutter::of`, the enclosing cylinder by design).
- No golden or snapshot changed. The changelog line, `Fixes #835`, "stacked on #837" and the not-exercised list are present. #842 is open for the kept laws (P2, area:sim, source:agent, effort:high). The decision file names the dropped option (docs/decisions/835-reach-reads-band-stack.md).

### Requested before merge
1. **Retarget before #837 merges.** Run `gh pr edit 843 --base main` first, then merge #837, then `git merge origin/main` on this branch and resolve `crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs` by keeping both module lines (`pub mod body_judged;` and `pub mod fixture_route;`). Re-gate after that merge.
2. **Make contiguity a checked law, not a producer invariant.** `BodyBands::of` (crates/sim/src/verify/body_bands.rs:61-82) never checks that each band starts where the previous one ends, or that the first starts at `shank_top`. Today's producers guarantee it, so no gap is reachable now, but a gap band would be silently unjudged, which is the failure the Prime Directive forbids. Add the check (each `above` within `EPS` of the running top, starting at `shank_top`; otherwise `None`) and a test with a gap band that expects `None`.
3. **Pin the foot-above-shank case and name its direction.** When the body's bottom is above `shank_top`, `HolderProfile::stack` fills the gap with a band at `shank_radius` (holder_profile.rs:217-219). The old cylinder judged that gap at `holder_radius`. Where the holder is wider than the shank this loosens the gap (the true shape there is the shank, so it is a correction, but it is a loosening); where the shank is wider it tightens. No test in tool_body_judged.rs covers it (there is no foot case), and the PR body does not state the direction. Add a pinning test for both sides and state the direction in the body.

### Law-by-law (item c): what moved, file and line
- **(c) shank/holder reach**: reach.rs:37-45 (holder group = `Cutter::judged(...).holder_bands()`), group loop reach.rs ~104-180. Moved. A case refused before can pass only where the cylinder was wider than the body (the stepped nose, pinned). Flange in the wall and nose in the wall stay ShankHit (pinned).
- **(c3) mid-turn sweep**: reach.rs:185-200 now receives the concatenated `bands` and the `shanked` list. Moved with (c).
- **(b2) solid law, containment kinds**: generate.rs:2572 (cutter built), 2754 and 3060 (`Some(cutter)`), contain_into at generate.rs:3212-3225 (now takes the cutter). Moved.
- **Posed rapids**: reads `Cutter::judged` through engine.rs:51. Moved (rapids_posed.rs not read line by line in this pass).
- **Rotary field law**: rotary_law.rs:41-50 and generate.rs:2979. Moved.
- **Kept the cylinder**: drill reach, cross-drill holder and part_clear (cross_part.rs:52), probe stylus (probe_op.rs:150-160). Not moved (#842).
- **Stricter case**: see requested item 3. It is not in the PR text I read, and it is not pinned.

### (c) de-duplication
The groups are independent: the shank group and the holder group each convict once (reach.rs:104-180), so one move can still carry one ShankHit per group, as before. Within the holder group the worst offender wins (`break` on `part == true`). Both groups push the same `Warning::ShankHit`, so no different refusal kind is hidden. The one loss: `shanked` (reach.rs:179, 204) suppresses the (c3) sweep on any move (c) already convicted, so a sweep-only `part == true` collision on that move is not reported. This was true before for one band; with more bands it can happen more often. Not blocking, but worth one line in the decision file.

### (d) kept-cylinder wording
`enclosure_words` (body_judged.rs:17-24) reads `tool.holder_d` and `flute_len + shank_len + holder_len`, the same judged record passed in as `judged_tool` (generate.rs run_job). The test checks it against `judged.holder_d` (tool_body_judged.rs:325-343). Note: `name_enclosure` only adds the words when the message contains "holder" (body_judged.rs:25-35). The drill-reach messages do; a kept-law message without the word would pass unnamed.

### (f) housekeeping
- File sizes: body_bands.rs 92, body_judged.rs 49, tool_body_judged.rs 343, reach.rs 238 (was 229), probe.rs 289 (was 246). generate.rs 3244 (was 3230) was already far past 400; flagged for growth, not blocking.
- Process files: none touched, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is needed.

### Not exercised (per the PR body) - gaps
- The foot-above-shank case: close it with requested item 3. A leaning body through (c)/(c3) is also unpinned; it can be left, but say so.
- A generated op with a body against a wall, and the rotary law with a body: not required for this merge, and the body already says so.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Is the `shanked` suppression of the (c3) sweep intended for bodies (see (c) de-duplication)?

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f74f878dc5321d52612b0d30fd3edac72ba51998 -->
Delta review on the cheap tier at the maintainer's instruction. This PR changes collision verdicts, so it is under AGENTS.md's safety floor and its review should run at the high tier; treat this pass as a first screen of the review-fix round, not the full verdict.

**Verdict: No blockers found in this first screen. Not merge-ready: the high-tier verdict is still owed before merge.**

### Earlier requests

1. **Merge of main, `operation/mod.rs`: resolved.** Both `pub mod body_judged;` (line 134) and `pub mod fixture_route;` (line 136) are present. The trial merge of head `f74f878d` with `origin/main` (bdd29e00, after #859) is clean, has no unmerged paths, and the sim and app test binaries and clippy build on it.
2. **Contiguity in `BodyBands::of` (crates/sim/src/verify/body_bands.rs:61-85): resolved.** A band whose start differs from the running top by more than `EPS` (1e-6 mm) returns `None`, so a gap, a late first band and an overlap all fall back to the enclosing cylinder. The tolerance is float dust only; a real gap cannot hide inside 1e-6 mm. `a_gapped_stack_is_refused_and_the_cylinder_stands` and `a_late_starting_stack_is_refused_and_the_cylinder_stands` assert the fallback (`holder_bands() == [(14, 20, 35)]`), not just `is_none()`. The overlap case asserts only `is_none()`; that is fine, since it is the same refusal branch.
3. **Raised foot: resolved, and the direction is stated** (PR body, decisions file `docs/decisions/835-reach-reads-band-stack.md`): looser where the body is wider than the shank, stricter where the shank is wider. Both sides are pinned in `crates/app/tests/tool_body_bands.rs` and pass. The slim case checks the record's cylinder ShankHit, the body's clean pass in the gap, and the body still convicted in the wall. The fat case checks the holder group adds a second conviction.
4. **Mid-turn sweep on a move (c) convicted: resolved.** See the sweep note below.

### Shank-radius argument (reviewed from the code)

I agree with keeping the shank radius. With a body attached, `tool_body::judged` (crates/app/src/tool_body.rs:164-175) replaces the record's holder with `HolderProfile::enclose`, so the record's holder is not judged or drawn in the gap. The gap band comes from `HolderProfile::stack` (crates/tools/src/holder_profile.rs:213-221) and only exists when `bottom() > shank_top`. `bottom()` is the first band's `above` (holder_profile.rs:187-189), and the envelope's first band starts at the mesh's own lowest vertex `z0`, so no body facet stands below its foot. What is left in the gap is the shank, which is a real cylinder there. The cylinder-based laws that remain (drill reach, probe, cross-part) still judge the gap at the body's widest radius through `enclose`, so only the band-stack laws changed. The thing to tell users is that an attached body is the whole holder: a collet nut or other holder steel has to be inside the imported mesh or drawn profile, because the record's holder is gone. That is a modelling rule, not a hole in the check, and the decisions file states it.

### Sweep change (crates/sim/src/verify/reach.rs:95-108, 183-186, 204-225): additive only

- Before: `mid_turn_sweeps` received `shanked`, so every move (c) convicted, stock or part, had no sweep.
- Now: it receives `shanked_part`, so a stock-only conviction still gets its sweep. The output of that sweep is filtered to drop only `SweepHit{part:false}` on moves in `shanked`. Those moves produced no sweep output before, so nothing that was emitted before is removed. The only change is an added `SweepHit{part:true}` on a stock-only move.
- It applies to tools without a body too, since `band_reach` runs on the cylinder bands for them.
- `a_swing_through_the_part_is_not_hidden_behind_a_stock_shank_hit` asserts `SweepHit{part:true}` and that `ShankHit{part:false}` is still present (crates/app/tests/tool_body_bands.rs). It passes.
- No existing count or golden changes: `verify`, `probe_reach`, `rotary_verify`, `turning_bore_feeds`, `operations` and the sim overhang, posed and rapid binaries all pass unchanged.

Non-blocking note: on a stock-only move the dropped `SweepHit{part:false}` is treated as the same event as the `ShankHit{part:false}`. A mid-turn stock contact at a different place in the move is therefore reported as the endpoint conviction only. Both block the post, so this is a wording point, not a safety gap.

### Still-open gaps (not blocking)

A tilted (posed) body through (c)/(c3), and the drill-reach, cross-drill and probe laws still on the cylinder, are tracked in #842. The posed and rotary paths share the per-band code, and the posed binaries pass. I would not block on these, but the (c)/(c3) tilted-body case is the cheapest one to pin next.

### Local results (trial merge with origin/main bdd29e00; head f74f878d)

| Target | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | builds |
| app `tool_body_bands` / `tool_body_judged` / `sim_tool_body` / `tool_spun_profile` / `tool_body` / `tool_body_view` / `verify` | 5 / 8 / 7 / 7 / 12 / 7 / 21 passed (2 ignored in `verify`, not run) |
| sim `fixture_mesh_posed` 9 (1 ignored), `midmove_pose` 5, `overhang_laws` 13, `posed_fixture` 7, `posed_fixture_midpose` 3, `posed_rapids` 5, `radial_rapids` 15, `ridge_reach` 5, `sideways_rapids` 3, `stock_posed` 3, `vertical_rapids` 16 | all pass (11 binaries, 0 failed) |
| motion `solid_law` | 6 passed |
| app `operations` 117 (6 ignored), `probe_reach` 5, `rotary_verify` 9, `turning_bore_feeds` 3 (warning-count suites) | all pass, 0 failed; the ignored ones not run |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the `--ignored` lanes, the release tier, the UI suites and the pixel snapshots, as the brief asked.

### Requested before merge

None blocking from this screen. The high-tier review should check the same points for the merge-ready verdict.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. The PR body still says "Retargeted to `main`" and the branch is `MERGEABLE` against bdd29e00. Keep it that way until merge.
2. Stating in the user guide that an attached body replaces the holder record (and so must include its steel) would help the user-facing side of the shank-radius decision.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
